# pve_node_replications (Data Source)

Lists the replication jobs on one node as reported by `GET /nodes/{node}/replication`, including each job's runtime sync state and job log. Fields the node omits for a given job are empty.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_node_replications" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node whose replication jobs to list.

### Optional

- `guest` (Number) Optional server-side filter listing only the jobs of this guest. Must be between 100 and 999999999.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for the node replication index.
- `replications` (Attributes List) Replication jobs on the node, with their runtime sync state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--replications))

<a id="nestedatt--replications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `replications`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Free-form description, empty when the job has none.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the job is disabled/deactivated.
- `duration` (Number) Duration of the last sync in seconds.
- `error` (String) Last sync error text, empty when the job is healthy.
- `fail_count` (Number) Number of consecutive failed syncs; 0 when the job is healthy.
- `guest` (Number) Guest ID the job replicates.
- `guest_name` (String) Name of the replicated guest (VM name or container hostname).
- `id` (String) Replication Job ID in the `<GUEST>-<JOBNUM>` form.
- `jobnum` (Number) Job number component of the replication job ID.
- `last_sync` (Number) Unix epoch time of the last successful sync, or 0 when the job never synced.
- `last_try` (Number) Unix epoch time of the last sync attempt, successful or not.
- `log` (List of String) Full replication job log lines, fetched per job from `GET /nodes/{node}/replication/{id}/log`. This issues one additional read-only API request per listed job; the endpoint has no side effects, so every row is populated.
- `next_sync` (Number) Unix epoch time of the next scheduled sync.
- `rate` (Number) Rate limit in MB/s, or null when the job is unlimited.
- `removal` (Boolean) Whether the job is marked for removal and its local snapshots are being cleaned up.
- `schedule` (String) Replication schedule as a `systemd` calendar event subset.
- `status` (String) Job state, e.g. `idle`, `syncing`, or `error`.
- `target` (String) Target node that receives the replicated volumes.
- `type` (String) Section type; `local` for storage replication.
